title: Arconte da Tempestade
prompt: Create a production pixel-art animation sprite sheet of the EXACT character in the reference. Reference is identity and material design: preserve silhouette, equipment, body parts, colors and proportions. Detailed silver-blue metal, warm golden trim, crisp clustered pixels matching the reference. Fixed camera and facing direction throughout. TRUE distinct whole-body drawings, changed joint angles and silhouettes, no rigid cutout rotation, no duplicated static pose. Every cell contains one complete isolated pose, not pieces. EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS, 16 equal square cells, read left-to-right. One animation per row, four sequential frames each. Transparent background alpha 0. No floor, text, numbers, grid lines, frames or scenery. Keep the whole figure INCLUDING effects within middle 65% width and 72% height of each cell, 15% clear gutters. SAME body scale across ALL 16 poses, feet on baseline 85%; a fallen corpse remains low and horizontal, never scaled up to fill the cell. No cropping of weapons or effects. Each row is a separate action; do not mix actions between rows. Four columns within each row correspond to four successive timestamps. Row 1 ATTACK: anticipation winding up, full extension at strike, follow-through, ready. The action is spear and cape sweep while a lightning arc is released. Row 2 SPECIAL: deep charge crouch, arms/head lift to concentrate energy, fully extended body releases a strong magical attack using this character's weapon or anatomy, exhausted recovery. Row 3 DEFENSE: ready, lower center of gravity and cross weapon/shield/arms in front of torso, brace under impact with knees deeply flexed, rise. Row 4 CELEBRATION or BOSS RAGE: low crouch, stand high with arms raised, powerful roar or victorious weapon lift, return. No new creatures, no extra weapons, no extra limbs.
